list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT bench_id FROM lr3_runs ORDER BY bench_id DESC

panels.title: lookup_hit: поиск существующих ключей
Среднее время операции во времени, N = ${size:text}
panels.description: Все фазы: warmup, measure, teardown. Среднее время операции в окнах по 50 мс.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t_s AS "Время (с)",
  round((avg_23_ns / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS "go1.23",
  round((avg_25_ns / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS "go1.25"
FROM lr3_timeline
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'lookup_hit'
  AND op = 'lookup_hit'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0')
ORDER BY t_s;

panels.title: Распределение по перцентилям, N = ${size:text}
panels.description: Фаза measure. По X время операции, по Y перцентиль: какая доля операций уложилась в это время. Пример: линия на высоте 90 при X = 7.5 мкс значит, что 90% операций выполнились за 7.5 мкс или быстрее. Точки — перцентили от p1 до p99 с шагом 1, затем p99.9 и p99.99.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round((u.p / 1000)::numeric, 3) AS "Время операции",
  CASE WHEN version = 'go1.23' THEN round((u.q * 100)::numeric, 2) END AS "go1.23",
  CASE WHEN version = 'go1.25' THEN round((u.q * 100)::numeric, 2) END AS "go1.25"
FROM lr3_dist
CROSS JOIN unnest(q, p_ns) AS u(q, p)
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'lookup_hit'
  AND op = 'lookup_hit'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0')
  AND u.q > 0 AND u.q < 1
ORDER BY u.p, version;

panels.title: Гистограмма времени операции (под столбцом границы бакета в мкс), N = ${size:text}
panels.description: Фаза measure, диапазон от p0.1 до p99, бакеты одинаковой ширины. Под столбцом — от какого до какого времени операции в бакете. По Y доля операций версии, попавших в бакет.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trim_scale(round(lo_us::numeric, 3)) || '–' || trim_scale(round(hi_us::numeric, 3)) AS "Бакет",
  v23::float8 / NULLIF(sum(v23) OVER (), 0) AS "go1.23",
  v25::float8 / NULLIF(sum(v25) OVER (), 0) AS "go1.25"
FROM lr3_hist
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'lookup_hit'
  AND op = 'lookup_hit'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0')
ORDER BY bin;

panels.title: Перцентили одной операции, мкс (фаза measure)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.5)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p50",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.5)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p50",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.75)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p75",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.75)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p75",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.9)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p90",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.9)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p90",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.95)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p95",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.95)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p95",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.99)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p99",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.99)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p99"
FROM lr3_dist
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'lookup_hit'
  AND op = 'lookup_hit'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0');

panels.title: Длительность теста и операций по фазам (на один прогон)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  avg((meta->>'total_duration_ns')::numeric) / 1e9 AS "Длительность теста",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'warmup'->>'lookup_hit')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23')) AS "go1.23 warmup",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'measure'->>'lookup_hit')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23')) AS "go1.23 measure",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'teardown'->>'lookup_hit')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23')) AS "go1.23 teardown",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'warmup'->>'lookup_hit')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25')) AS "go1.25 warmup",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'measure'->>'lookup_hit')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25')) AS "go1.25 measure",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'teardown'->>'lookup_hit')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25')) AS "go1.25 teardown"
FROM lr3_runs
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'lookup_hit'
  AND size = $size
  AND (run::text = '$run' OR '$run' = 'All');

panels.description: Все фазы: warmup, measure, teardown. Среднее время операции в окнах по 50 мс. Ось Y логарифмическая: ожидание блокировки даёт выбросы в тысячи раз больше типичного значения.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t_s AS "Время (с)",

  round((avg_25_ns / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS "go1.25"

panels.title: Распределение по перцентилям (до p99), N = ${size:text}
panels.description: Фаза measure. По X время операции, по Y перцентиль: какая доля операций уложилась в это время. Пример: линия на высоте 90 при X = 7.5 мкс значит, что 90% операций выполнились за 7.5 мкс или быстрее. Показано до p99: дальше хвост из-за ожидания блокировки доходит до десятков миллисекунд и сжал бы остальной график в линию.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round((u.p / 1000)::numeric, 3) AS "Время операции",
  CASE WHEN version = 'go1.23' THEN round((u.q * 100)::numeric, 2) END AS "go1.23",
  CASE WHEN version = 'go1.25' THEN round((u.q * 100)::numeric, 2) END AS "go1.25"
FROM lr3_dist
CROSS JOIN unnest(q, p_ns) AS u(q, p)
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'mixed'
  AND op = 'mixed_read'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0')
  AND u.q > 0 AND u.q <= 0.99
ORDER BY u.p, version;

panels.title: Распределение по перцентилям (до p99), N = ${size:text}
panels.description: Фаза measure. По X время операции, по Y перцентиль: какая доля операций уложилась в это время. Пример: линия на высоте 90 при X = 7.5 мкс значит, что 90% операций выполнились за 7.5 мкс или быстрее. Показано до p99: дальше хвост из-за ожидания блокировки доходит до десятков миллисекунд и сжал бы остальной график в линию.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round((u.p / 1000)::numeric, 3) AS "Время операции",
  CASE WHEN version = 'go1.23' THEN round((u.q * 100)::numeric, 2) END AS "go1.23",
  CASE WHEN version = 'go1.25' THEN round((u.q * 100)::numeric, 2) END AS "go1.25"
FROM lr3_dist
CROSS JOIN unnest(q, p_ns) AS u(q, p)
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'mixed'
  AND op = 'mixed_write'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0')
  AND u.q > 0 AND u.q <= 0.99
ORDER BY u.p, version;

panels.title: Гистограмма времени операции (под столбцом границы бакета в мкс), N = ${size:text}
panels.description: Фаза measure, диапазон от p0.1 до p99, бакеты одинаковой ширины. Под столбцом — от какого до какого времени операции в бакете. По Y доля операций версии, попавших в бакет.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trim_scale(round(lo_us::numeric, 3)) || '–' || trim_scale(round(hi_us::numeric, 3)) AS "Бакет",
  v23::float8 / NULLIF(sum(v23) OVER (), 0) AS "go1.23",
  v25::float8 / NULLIF(sum(v25) OVER (), 0) AS "go1.25"
FROM lr3_hist
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'mixed'
  AND op = 'mixed_write'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0')
ORDER BY bin;

panels.title: Перцентили одной операции, мкс (фаза measure)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.5)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p50",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.5)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p50",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.75)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p75",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.75)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p75",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.9)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p90",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.9)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p90",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.95)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p95",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.95)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p95",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.99)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23') / 1000 AS "go1.23 p99",
  max(p_ns[array_position(q, 0.99)]) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25') / 1000 AS "go1.25 p99"
FROM lr3_dist
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'mixed'
  AND op = 'mixed_write'
  AND size = $size
  AND run::text = replace('$run', 'All', '0');

panels.title: Длительность теста и операций по фазам (на один прогон)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  avg((meta->>'total_duration_ns')::numeric) / 1e9 AS "Длительность теста",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'warmup'->>'mixed_write')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23')) AS "go1.23 warmup",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'measure'->>'mixed_write')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23')) AS "go1.23 measure",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'teardown'->>'mixed_write')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.23')) AS "go1.23 teardown",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'warmup'->>'mixed_write')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25')) AS "go1.25 warmup",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'measure'->>'mixed_write')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25')) AS "go1.25 measure",
  round(avg((meta->'counts'->'teardown'->>'mixed_write')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE version = 'go1.25')) AS "go1.25 teardown"
FROM lr3_runs
WHERE bench_id = '$bench'
  AND scenario = 'mixed'
  AND size = $size
  AND (run::text = '$run' OR '$run' = 'All');
